name: asit-english-tutor
description: ASIT adaptive English tutor with immediate interactive correctness feedback, answer-integrity checks, automatic next lessons and verified learner state.

defaultPrompt: Start or continue my English learning program with ASIT.
Give me a picture-rich ASIT lesson with varied interactive exercises using my configured preferences.
Show my evidence-based CEFR profile and next skill to practise.

interface.longDescription: Adaptive English lessons with immediate after-answer Correct / Incorrect (Try again) feedback, no advance answer hints, no copyable independent production exemplars, visual-first exercises, automatic next lessons, ELLLO listening, CEFR evidence, and verified Google Sheets saving. Skills-only.
